result.response:
The bug has been fixed and verified against the requirements.

### Cause of the Bug
When an [`XmlMapper`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_d_fix/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/XmlMapper.java) was copied, its underlying [`XmlSerializerProvider`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_d_fix/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/ser/XmlSerializerProvider.java) shared the existing [`XmlRootNameLookup`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_d_fix/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/util/XmlRootNameLookup.java) instance (`_rootNameLookup = src._rootNameLookup;`). As a consequence, cached root element names from annotations were reused in the copied mapper even when annotations were disabled via configuration on the copy.

### Solution
Updated [`XmlSerializerProvider`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_d_fix/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/ser/XmlSerializerProvider.java#L55-L60) copy constructor to initialize a fresh `new XmlRootNameLookup()` rather than copying the lookup cache reference from the source provider.

The patch has been saved to [`enlightened_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_d_fix/enlightened_fix.patch).
